# Introduction

This assignment analyzes student performance data.

```{r}
# Load data
data <- data.frame(
  student = 1:20,
  math_score = rnorm(20, mean = 75, sd = 10),
  science_score = rnorm(20, mean = 80, sd = 8)
)

# Basic statistics
summary(data)
```

# Analysis

```{r}
# Plot math scores
plot(data$math_score, main = "Math Scores", xlab = "Student", ylab = "Score")

# Plot science scores  
plot(data$science_score, main = "Science Scores", xlab = "Student", ylab = "Score")

# Scatter plot comparison
plot(data$math_score, data$science_score, 
     xlab = "Math Score", ylab = "Science Score",
     main = "Math vs Science Scores")
```

# Conclusion

The analysis shows the relationship between math and science scores.
